meta.doc: Machine-readable notes on the public cluster web API surface used/probed by this tool.
meta.policy: public, unauthenticated endpoints only; a handful of probes; no endpoint enumeration/bruteforce
meta.secretPolicy: API-key/token value classes documented in prose only; no key literals in this repository

hosts.telemetry: cl4r.net (client-side analytics; unused by this tool)

notes: Non-secret build identifiers reproduced from the public web client; overridable per run.
No Authorization header is ever sent by this tool.
Plain product token without parentheses (HTTP client comment-splitting caveat).
404 with id envelope when world id is unknown/not publicly accessible.
Unknown/unmodeled response fields are preserved by WorldMetadata.Extra.

endpoints.auth: Firebase Authorization header (from the normal client session)
endpoints.status: verified: GET probe -> 405 method_not_allowed (POST-only); authenticated flow required
notes: Response embeds RoomEnterResponse.venue (RoomVenue) incl. platformResources manifest.
This tool stops at the no-auth boundary; see docs/RESEARCH.md section 3.
Deep-link fetch used before entering; same trust level as enter_v2.

endpoints.status: verified: 404 UNREGISTERED_ROOM for a room GUID (rooms are runtime sessions)
verified: 405 (PATCH-only management space); also 405 for a world GUID id class

clientDeliveryChain.summary: Venue bundle manifest (RoomVenue.platformResources with UnityAsset/UnityResource assetBundleUrl entries) is delivered ONLY via the authenticated room-enter flow.
clientDeliveryChain.http: UnityWebRequest against absolute assetBundleUrl values from the manifest
clientDeliveryChain.caveat: Some venue assets pass through AesAssetDecryptor (IAssetDecryptor) after download; raw bytes of such entries are encrypted.
clientDeliveryChain.boundaryDecision: No public unauthenticated delivery endpoint exists; emulating guest/Firebase authentication is out of scope for this tool. The resolver therefore reports DeliveryStatus.NotImplemented (exit code 2).
